run_speech_recognition_inference: run speech recognition inference on audio data using a trained AV-HuBERT model checkpoint
run_inference_with_noise_augmentation: run inference with configurable noise probability, SNR, and noise wav file for robustness testing
run_inference_with_modality_selection: run inference selecting specific modalities like audio or video for the AV-HuBERT model
run_inference_and_compute_wer: run inference on a test dataset and compute word error rate (WER) with results saved to JSON
run_inference_with_hydra_config: run inference using Hydra configuration with profiling support and distributed training options
